text:
chris: Heads-up — seeing a 3x spike in Xid 79 + 48 on us-west2 embedder pool starting ~22:41 UTC, correlates with tenant-99 small-batch traffic. Logs: `Xid 79 NVDEC ECC` repeated. Any ideas? :eyes:
marie: copy, pulling telemetry. Do we have runbook link? Might be noisy card or driver. tenant-99 started gradient offload last deploy?
chris: runbook linked: <https://redwood/ops/runbooks/xid-triage> but quick snip of sample dmesg: ```[12345.678901] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3d:00.0: Xid (79:10:0) GPU has fallen off the bus```
infra-oncall: I see ECC counters rising on the same host: mem_ecc: +480 over 10m. Suggest soft-drain and repro on same kernel.
ben: what's the batch shape? tenant-99 uses many seq_len=2048 small batch=1 bursts. That tends to keep KV hot and memory fragmentation high.
carmen: also seeing pcie resets in syslog on 3 hosts. Might be power/cable or rails. Running `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` shows single-bit errs.
chris: started soft-drain on 3 nodes (host-239, host-241, host-244) — will keep warm standby. If we see Xid13 follow up, escalate to hard drain.
srebot: alert created: <https://redwood/alerts/IR-2026-333> Incident #IR-2026-333 - Xid spike us-west2
marie: quick correlation: tenant-99 op_type=embedder spikes align with Xid 79 rate up to 0.6% of requests — oddly higher on A10s in that rack.
ben: probable hypothesis: memory fragmentation + continuous KV growth for long seqs. Try enabling periodic KV cache eviction for that model.
infra-oncall: repro plan: 1) fork tenant traffic to test pool 2) run stress with same batchshape + rai 3) monitor ECC counters + dmesg. Who wants to own?
chris: i'll own the repro. starting fork now, will attach perf counters.
mamun: if repro confirms noisy cards, prefer replacement over repeated reboots — we've seen recurring Xid79 on same pcie slot.
carmen: driver version on affected hosts is 525.105; any chance regressions? We recently rolled kernel 6.2 -> some ABI churn.
ben: try rolling driver to 520 in test pool as A/B. If it's driver, Xid codes sometimes shift.
infra-oncall: cost note: if we move tenant-99 to dedicated instances to reduce noisy neighbor, monthly delta ~ $5k but reduces tail failures.
chris: update in 20m. current stats: Xid79 3.1x, Xid48 ~1.2x, single-bit ECC up 0.4%. :thumbsup:
marie: thanks — ping when repro results. If repro fails, we'll open a hardware RMA ticket.
chris: repro run completed — reproduced Xid79 on host-241 within 6 min of staged traffic. Attached kernel snippet: ```NVRM: Xid (79:9:0) PTX fatal```
infra-oncall: schedule hardware swap for host-241 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Marking as flaky card. Also flag host-244 for follow-up.
ben: in parallel, PR to model-serving to add `kv_cache_eviction_ms=300000` to tail-sensitive models.
carmen: note for runbook: add section "when Xid79 + ECC increase and small-batch embedder" with steps: repro -> soft-drain -> swap -> RMA.
chris: good. closing loop — will update incident IR-2026-333 with timeline.
mamun: great work everyone. :tada:
